full_details: In the morning Mistress Ansell filled the brass horn from the Monday copper. Galls, copperas, and gum. Twopence. You ate at the board and went to the Theatre. You opened as Egeon and were idle until the end. You did not cross for The Disguises. After supper you wrote the first fourteen lines of the lovers' play, last, for your own mouth. The sheet shows two houses of one dignity, and the two hours' traffic of the stage. You did not rule it. Then you turned to the Verona page of 6 March and wrote dignitie into the gap. Both houses are the same. Neither is the wicked one.
one_sentence: You opened Errors as Egeon and were done after the opening, and at ten you wrote the first fourteen lines and filled the March gap with dignitie.
title: Egeon, and one word in a March gap
